title: OpenBSE Input Schema
description: Complete schema definition for OpenBSE YAML input files. Analogous to the EnergyPlus IDD — defines every class, field, type, allowed values, units, and defaults. Use this to build editors, validators, and programmatic interfaces.

weather_files.description: Weather file paths (EPW or CSV). Supports multiple for multi-year runs.

performance_curves.description: Reusable performance curves for equipment. Referenced by name from components.

air_loops.description: Air-side HVAC loops (AHUs, RTUs, FCUs, DOAS units).

plant_loops.description: Water-side plant loops (hot water, chilled water).

zone_groups.description: Named groups of zones for referencing in thermostats and loads.

thermostats.description: Zone thermostat definitions with heating/cooling setpoints.

controls.description: Setpoint controllers for coils and plant loops.

parametrics.description: Optional parametric run definitions for batch analysis.

schedules.description: Named schedule profiles for time-varying inputs.

constructions.description: Opaque constructions defined as material layers (outside to inside).

window_constructions.description: Window constructions defined by U-factor and SHGC.

simple_constructions.description: Simplified constructions defined by U-factor and lumped thermal capacity.

f_factor_constructions.description: F-factor ground floor constructions (perimeter-based slab heat loss, Q = F × P × (T_zone − T_ground)). Matches EnergyPlus Construction:FfactorGroundFloor. Surfaces using these must specify `exposed_perimeter`.

shading_surfaces.description: External shading surfaces (overhangs, fins, neighboring buildings). These only cast shadows — no thermal mass. Requires `simulation.shading_calculation: detailed`.

equipment.description: Internal equipment gain definitions assignable to zones.

ventilation.description: Mechanical ventilation definitions assignable to zones.

exhaust_fans.description: Exhaust fan definitions assignable to zones.

outdoor_air.description: Outdoor air requirement definitions for minimum ventilation sizing.

ideal_loads.description: Ideal loads air systems for zone load testing without real HVAC.

dhw_systems.description: Domestic hot water systems (water heater, draw loads, optional recirculation pump).

vrf_systems.description: Variable refrigerant flow systems (one outdoor unit serving per-zone indoor units).

radiant_panels.description: Zone-level radiant panels (fin-tube radiators, chilled ceilings, electric panels).

exterior_equipment.description: Exterior equipment — facility-level loads not in any zone (exterior lighting, signage, etc.).

equipment_it.description: IT server loads, tracked separately from general equipment for ASHRAE 90.4 PUE/MLC/ELC reporting. Processed identically to `equipment` in the zone heat balance but reported under the IT equipment end use. If `submeter` is omitted, auto-assigned to "datacenter".

electrical_distribution.description: UPS and transformer losses for ASHRAE 90.4 ELC calculation.

climate_zone.description: ASHRAE climate zone (e.g. "5A") — used for ASHRAE 90.4 PUE/MLC/ELC compliance limits in the summary report. Optional; limits show "Unknown" if omitted.

summary_report.description: Whether to generate the standard summary report.

ComfortGrid.description: Spatial thermal comfort grid (opt-in). Lays occupant points on each zone's floor and gives each its own mean radiant temperature and direct-sun exposure, written to <stem>_comfort.json for the Workbench's Comfort tab. Zone air is well mixed, so air temperature and humidity are uniform within a zone: the grid shows radiant and solar variation only, not a CFD air field. Zones need vertices on all their surfaces.

wall_offset.description: Minimum distance from points to the floor edge [m].

height.description: Point height above the floor [m]. Defaults to 0.6 for seated or sphere, 1.1 for standing.

occupant.description: How points weight the surfaces they see: ISO 7726 seated or standing person (averaged over facing direction), or a uniform sphere like a globe thermometer.

zones.description: Zones to grid. Empty means every zone whose surfaces all have vertices.

pmv_limit.description: |PMV| at or below this counts as comfortable in the annual statistics.

timesteps_per_hour.description: Number of simulation timesteps per hour.

current_timestep_predictor.description: Evaluate the HVAC mode predictor with the current timestep's gains and weather (refreshed once after the first HVAC iteration) instead of carrying it over from the previous timestep. Removes the one-timestep start-up lag when a load switches on in a lightweight, idle zone.

terrain.description: Site terrain for wind profile calculations.

shading_calculation.description: Shading mode. 'detailed' enables geometric shadow calculations.

infiltration_interaction.description: How infiltration combines with exhaust. 'ashrae_combined' uses sqrt(infil^2 + exhaust^2).

ground_surface_temperatures.description: Monthly ground surface temperatures [C], January through December, for surfaces with `boundary: ground`. Matches EnergyPlus Site:GroundTemperature:BuildingSurface.

heating_sizing_factor.description: Heating sizing factor applied to zone design loads and airflows (EnergyPlus Sizing:Parameters). 1.25 = 25% safety margin.

cooling_sizing_factor.description: Cooling sizing factor applied to zone design loads and airflows (EnergyPlus Sizing:Parameters). 1.15 = 15% safety margin.

sizing_fan_delta_t.description: Fan heat temperature rise added to the cooling design supply air temperature when sizing zone cooling airflows [C]. ~2.2 for typical VAV office systems.

holidays.description: Holiday dates. On these days every schedule uses its `holiday` profile (falling back to sunday → weekend → weekday). Matches EnergyPlus RunPeriodControl:SpecialDays (Holiday).

run_parametrics.description: Whether to execute parametric runs defined in the parametrics section. Set to false to run the base model only without deleting parametric definitions.

AirflowNetworkConfig.description: Multizone pressure network airflow configuration. When enabled, auto-generates a pressure network from building geometry and solves for pressure-driven infiltration using Newton-Raphson.

cp_model.description: Wind pressure coefficient model: a named correlation, or a user Cp table interpolated from the EPW wind direction (YAML tag form: `cp_model: !table`).

wind_angles.description: Wind directions [deg from north], ascending, within [0, 360).

azimuth.description: Facade outward normal azimuth [deg from north].

cp.description: Cp value per entry in wind_angles.

default_crack_exponent.description: Flow exponent n for auto-generated cracks.

wall_leakage_per_area.description: Crack leakage per unit wall area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

window_leakage_per_area.description: Crack leakage per unit window area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

door_leakage_per_perimeter.description: Crack leakage per unit door perimeter [kg/s/m/Pa^n].

interzone_leakage_per_area.description: Interzone crack leakage per unit area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

ach50.description: Blower-door calibration: measured air changes per hour at 50 Pa. Scales exterior crack coefficients to match.

facade_shelter.description: Per-facade wind shelter multipliers (AIM-2 style). Nearest facade by azimuth applies; folds into wind pressure as multiplier squared.

azimuth.description: Facade outward normal azimuth [deg from north].

wall_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for exterior walls. Overrides wall_leakage_per_area.

window_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for windows. Overrides window_leakage_per_area.

interzone_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for interzone surfaces. Overrides interzone_leakage_per_area.

damping.description: Damping factor for pressure updates (starting factor when adaptive_damping is on).

adaptive_damping.description: Adapt the Newton under-relaxation factor per iteration: grow toward a full step while the residual falls, cut on overshoot.

relative_tolerance.description: Relative convergence tolerance: accept when the worst zone mass residual is below this fraction of total network through-flow.

species.description: Passive species (e.g. CO2) transported on the network flows.

name.description: Species name, referenced by zone species_generation entries.

hvac_filter_efficiency.description: Filter removal efficiency applied to recirculated supply air.

generation_per_met_watt.description: Occupant-linked generation [kg/s per W metabolic heat]; CO2 ~6.9e-8. Follows occupancy schedules.

LeakageClass.description: ASHRAE construction leakage class (ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch. 16 Table 1): a=tight, b=average, c=leaky, d=very leaky.

SurfaceAirflowOverride.description: Per-surface overrides for the airflow network auto-generation.

large_opening.description: Treat surface as a large opening (door, operable window).

discharge_coefficient.description: Override discharge coefficient Cd for large opening.

opening_fraction.description: Opening area as fraction of surface area.

opening_schedule.description: Schedule name modulating the opening fraction each timestep [0-1]. 0 closes the opening.

DesignDay.description: Design day definition for autosizing calculations.

day_type.description: Design day type. Matched by substring: values containing 'summer' or 'cool' are cooling design days; 'winter' or 'heat' are heating design days.

internal_gains.description: Internal gains during this design day: off (0%), full (100% at all hours), scheduled (follow normal schedules), full_when_occupied (full when schedule > 0). Defaults by day_type: heating → off, cooling → full.

taub.description: ASHRAE Tau solar model beam optical depth (cooling design days).

taud.description: ASHRAE Tau solar model diffuse optical depth (cooling design days).

cooling_setpoint_schedule.description: Hourly cooling setpoints for this design day [C], hours 1–24. Overrides the thermostat's constant cooling setpoint during sizing (models setup/pulldown).

AutosizeOrNumber.description: Either a numeric value or the string 'autosize' to let the engine calculate.

CurveType.description: Mathematical form of the performance curve.

PerformanceCurve.description: Reusable performance curve. Modifies rated equipment performance as a function of operating conditions. Give either a polynomial (`curve_type` + `coefficients`, optional bounds) or a manufacturer data `table` (N-linear interpolation), not both.

name.description: Unique curve name for referencing from components.

coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients. Count depends on curve_type: linear=2, quadratic=3, cubic=4, biquadratic=6.

axes.description: Independent-variable axes. When a table is used positionally (cap-fT, EIR-fT, ...), x maps to the first axis and y to the second.

variable.description: Physical variable this axis represents (temperatures in [C], fractions in [0-1]).

extrapolation.description: Behavior outside the breakpoints: clamp to the edge value, or extrapolate linearly.

values.description: Row-major output values (axis 0 varies slowest). Length must equal the product of the axis lengths. May also be given as a nested list of rows, which is flattened.

AirLoopSystemType.description: HVAC system type hint. Usually auto-detected from equipment and controls. dual_duct = dual-duct constant air volume (hot + cold deck blended at each zone mixing box); crac = computer-room air conditioner (self-contained DX, no OA mixing); crah = computer-room air handler (chilled-water coil, no OA mixing). Descriptive aliases are accepted: variable_air_volume (=vav), dedicated_outdoor_air (=doas), fan_coil_unit (=fcu), packaged_terminal (=ptac), packaged_terminal_heat_pump (=pthp), packaged_single_zone (=psz_ac), dual_duct_cav (=dual_duct).

CyclingMethod.description: Capacity control method. on_off = cycling compressor; proportional = modulating output.

EconomizerType.description: Economizer control strategy for free cooling. differential_enthalpy: OA enthalpy < return enthalpy. fixed_enthalpy: OA enthalpy < high_limit_enthalpy. enthalpy_with_high_limit: differential enthalpy AND OA temp < high_limit.

high_limit.description: High limit shutoff temperature [C] (for fixed_dry_bulb and enthalpy_with_high_limit).

high_limit_enthalpy.description: High limit shutoff enthalpy [J/kg] (for fixed_enthalpy and enthalpy_with_high_limit). Default: 65200 J/kg (~28 BTU/lb, ASHRAE 90.1).

max_outdoor_temp.description: Additional fixed outdoor dry-bulb limit [C], AND-ed with the economizer_type test.

max_outdoor_enthalpy.description: Additional fixed outdoor enthalpy limit [J/kg], AND-ed with the economizer_type test.

load_reset.description: Reset the economizer mixed-air target to the supply temperature that just meets the zone cooling load, within these bounds.

min_supply_temp.description: Lowest supply-air temperature the reset may ask for [C].

max_supply_temp.description: Highest supply-air temperature the reset may ask for [C].

compressor_lockout.description: Non-integrated economizer: the compressor and the economizer never run together.

AirLoopControls.description: Control parameters for an air loop.

design_zone_flow.description: Design air flow rate per zone [kg/s]. Use 'autosize' for auto-calculation.

minimum_damper_position.description: Minimum outdoor air damper position [0-1]. Set to 1.0 for DOAS. If omitted, auto-calculated from zone outdoor air requirements (falls back to 0.20 if no outdoor_air definitions exist).

minimum_oa_schedule.description: Schedule whose hourly value multiplies the minimum outdoor-air fraction (proportional minimum). Seasonal schedules are honored.

cooling_sat_reset.description: Cooling supply air temperature reset (absent = fixed SAT).

heating_sat_reset.description: Heating supply air temperature reset (absent = fixed SAT).

outdoor_air_fraction.description: Explicit outdoor air fraction [0-1] for CRAC/CRAH systems. Overrides minimum_damper_position when set.

cooling_part_load_cd.description: Cooling cycling degradation coefficient Cd for PLF = 1 − Cd·(1−PLR), applied to compressor and condenser-fan energy at part load. 0.15 = EnergyPlus default; ASHRAE 140 HVAC BESTEST uses 0.229.

return_fan_pressure_rise.description: Return-fan design pressure rise [Pa] (absent = no return fan). Heats the return air before it mixes with outdoor air.

return_fan_total_efficiency.description: Return-fan total efficiency [0-1]. Only used when return_fan_pressure_rise is set.

fixed_cooling_sat.description: Hold the central cooling coil at a fixed leaving-air temperature (cooling_supply_temp) instead of the warmest-zone reset.

preheat_setpoint.description: Central preheat-coil leaving-air setpoint [C]. When set, the AHU heating coil holds this temperature to temper the mixed air (otherwise frost protection only).

minimum_oa_flow.description: Fixed minimum outdoor-air volume flow [m3/s], held regardless of supply flow (E+ Controller:OutdoorAir FixedMinimum). Overrides minimum_damper_position as the OA floor.

FanOperatingMode.description: Fan operating mode. cycling = fan cycles with coils (off in deadband); continuous = fan always at full speed; continuous_no_load_off = full speed while heating/cooling, off in deadband (E+ PTAC with no-load flow = 0).

OaSatReset.description: Reset SAT linearly with outdoor air temperature (ASHRAE 90.1 G3.1.3.12).

oa_low.description: Outdoor temperature at which SAT = sat_max [C].

oa_high.description: Outdoor temperature at which SAT = sat_min [C].

DemandSatReset.description: Reset SAT upward until the most-loaded VAV box reaches 100% open.

SingleZoneSatReset.description: Reset SAT each timestep to hold the control zone exactly at setpoint (EnergyPlus SetpointManager:SingleZone).

source.description: Fan type: constant_volume, vav (variable volume) or on_off. Other values are rejected.

tag.description: Free-form tag for output classification (e.g. supply, return, exhaust, transfer, relief). Used for end-use subcategory reporting.

design_flow_rate.description: Design air volume flow rate [m3/s]. May be omitted when a205_file is set (the file's nominal flow is used).

a205_file.description: Path to an ASHRAE Standard 205 RS0003 fan performance file (.a205 CBOR or .a205.json). Relative paths resolve against the model YAML directory. When set, the analytical efficiencies and VAV coefficients are ignored; pressure_rise is still the static-pressure query.

motor_a205_file.description: Optional standalone ASHRAE 205 RS0005 motor file. Replaces the motor embedded in a205_file. Only used when a205_file is set.

drive_a205_file.description: Optional standalone RS0007 mechanical (belt) drive file. Replaces the drive embedded in a205_file. Only used when a205_file is set.

vfd_a205_file.description: Optional standalone RS0006 electronic motor drive (VFD) file. Replaces the VFD nested in the motor. Only used when a205_file is set.

impeller_efficiency.description: Impeller (fan blade) efficiency [0-1]. Total efficiency = motor * impeller.

motor_in_airstream_fraction.description: Fraction of motor waste heat entering the airstream [0-1].

air_density.description: Fixed air density [kg/m3] for the fan power calculation. Default: actual fan-inlet density. Set the standard density (about 1.204 at sea level) to rate the fan at standard air, as EnergyPlus does.

vav_coefficients.description: VAV fan power curve coefficients [C1..C5]: power fraction = C1 + C2*PLR + C3*PLR^2 + C4*PLR^3 + C5*PLR^4. Default: typical ASHRAE forward-curved centrifugal fan.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

source.description: Heating energy source. heat_pump = air-source heat pump DX heating coil (uses cop instead of efficiency). 'furnace' is accepted as an alias of gas, 'hp' of heat_pump.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

efficiency.description: Heating efficiency [0-1]. 1.0 for electric, <1.0 for gas. Ignored for hot_water source (boiler handles efficiency).

parasitic_electric_load.description: On-cycle parasitic electric load [W] for gas coils (draft / inducer fan). Runs with the burner; adds no heat to the supply air.

rated_airflow.description: Rated airflow [m3/s] (heat_pump source only). 0 = derived from capacity (~500 CFM/ton).

supplemental_capacity.description: Supplemental electric resistance capacity [W] (heat_pump source only; 0 = none).

lockout_temp.description: Compressor low-temperature lockout [C] (heat_pump source only). Default: -17.78 (0 F).

cap_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for capacity f(T_outdoor) (heat_pump source only).

eir_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for EIR f(T_outdoor) (heat_pump source only).

plant_loop.description: Hot water plant loop this coil connects to (hot_water source only).

ua_model.description: Use the UA-based (NTU-effectiveness cross-flow) model for hot water coils instead of the simple capacity-based model.

rated_water_inlet_temp.description: Rated water inlet temperature [C] for the UA model (default 82.2).

rated_water_outlet_temp.description: Rated water outlet temperature [C] for the UA model (default 71.1).

rated_air_inlet_temp.description: Rated air inlet temperature [C] for the UA model (default 16.6).

rated_air_outlet_temp.description: Rated air outlet temperature [C] for the UA model (default 32.2).

CoolingCoil.description: Cooling coil component (DX or chilled water).

source.description: Cooling energy source. 'chw' is accepted as an alias of chilled_water.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

capacity.description: Rated total cooling capacity [W] at ARI conditions. May be omitted when a205_file is set.

cop.description: Rated COP (coefficient of performance). DX source only; ignored when a205_file is set.

a205_file.description: Path to an ASHRAE Standard 205 RS0004 DX performance file (.a205 CBOR or .a205.json). Relative paths resolve against the model YAML directory. When set, curves on this coil are ignored. DX source only.

condenser_fan_power.description: Rated outdoor (condenser) fan power [W], DX source only. Runs with the compressor; reported under cooling electricity.

cap_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for capacity f(T_wb, T_outdoor).

eir_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for EIR f(T_wb, T_outdoor).

plf_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for part-load fraction f(PLR).

cap_fflow_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for capacity f(flow fraction).

eir_fflow_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for EIR f(flow fraction).

autocalculate_shr.description: Compute SHR each timestep with the apparatus dew point / bypass factor method (E+ style). false = constant rated SHR.

dry_coil_wet_bulb_iteration.description: When the DX coil runs dry, evaluate capacity/EIR curves at the wet-bulb at which the coil would just be dry (as EnergyPlus does). Only used with autocalculate_shr.

design_water_flow_rate.description: Design chilled water flow rate [m3/s] (chilled_water source only).

design_water_inlet_temp.description: Design chilled water supply temperature [C] (chilled_water source only).

design_water_outlet_temp.description: Design chilled water return temperature [C] (chilled_water source only).

plant_loop.description: Chilled water plant loop this coil connects to (chilled_water source only).

HeatRecovery.description: Air-to-air heat recovery component (energy recovery ventilator).

source.description: Heat recovery device type. Wheels transfer both sensible and latent; plates are sensible-only.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

exhaust_flow_ratio.description: Exhaust-to-supply mass flow ratio [0-1]. Recovery is limited by the exhaust stream when it carries less flow than supply (typical with building pressurization).

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

speeds.description: Speed stages ordered from lowest to highest capacity.

rated_capacity.description: Total cooling capacity at rated conditions [W].

shr.description: Sensible heat ratio at rated conditions [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

GroundTempSource.description: How the GSHP determines entering water temperature from the ground: auto (Kusuda-Achenbach model from weather-file annual stats), epw_monthly (EPW header monthly ground temps, falls back to auto), or {monthly: [12 values]} user-specified monthly temperatures [C], January–December.

monthly.description: Monthly ground temperatures [C], January through December.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

cooling_cap_ft.description: Optional cooling capacity f(EWT, indoor DBT) curve name.

cooling_eir_ft.description: Optional cooling EIR f(EWT, indoor DBT) curve name.

heating_cap_ft.description: Optional heating capacity f(EWT, indoor DBT) curve name.

heating_eir_ft.description: Optional heating EIR f(EWT, indoor DBT) curve name.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

zone_cooling_setpoint.description: Zone cooling setpoint [C] used as the reference for the RH to humidity-ratio conversion.

Duct.description: Air duct with conduction losses and leakage.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

leakage_fraction.description: Fraction of air lost through leaks [0-1].

ambient_zone.description: Surroundings of the duct: 'outdoor', 'ground', or a zone name.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

mode.description: direct = adiabatic (adds moisture); indirect = HX using wet-bulb as driving temperature (no moisture added); two_stage = indirect followed by direct.

effectiveness.description: Saturation effectiveness of the direct stage [0-1].

hx_effectiveness.description: Heat exchanger effectiveness of the indirect stage [0-1].

ExternalAir.description: Air-side co-simulation proxy. Delegates each timestep to an external process via stdin/stdout JSON.

command.description: Command line used to launch the co-simulation process (e.g. [python, ahu_model.py]).

inputs.description: Input variable names sent to the process each timestep (e.g. inlet_temp_c, inlet_humidity_ratio, inlet_mass_flow_kg_s, outdoor_temp_c, sim_time_s).

outputs.description: Output variable names expected back each timestep (e.g. outlet_temp_c, outlet_humidity_ratio, power_w).

Equipment.description: An air-side equipment component. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

VavBox.description: Variable air volume terminal with optional reheat coil.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

max_reheat_fraction.description: Maximum flow fraction during reheat [0-1] (E+ Damper Heating Action). Set equal to min_flow_fraction for reheat-first control; default 0.5 (ASHRAE G36 dual-maximum).

plant_loop.description: Hot water plant loop for hot_water reheat.

PfpBox.description: Parallel fan-powered terminal box with secondary fan and electric reheat.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

secondary_air_temp.description: Secondary (plenum) air temperature [C]. Default: zone return air temperature.

DualDuctBox.description: Dual-duct constant-volume mixing box that blends hot and cold deck supply air.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

min_flow_fraction.description: Minimum flow fraction for each damper [0-1].

Terminal.description: Zone terminal box. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

ZoneConnection.description: Zone served by an air loop.

terminal.description: Optional terminal box (VAV, PFP, or dual-duct). Omit for a direct connection.

per_person_oa.description: DCV outdoor air per person [m3/s-person] (ASHRAE 62.1 Rp). Only used when dcv is true on the air loop.

per_area_oa.description: DCV outdoor air per floor area [m3/s-m2] (ASHRAE 62.1 Ra). Only used when dcv is true on the air loop.

AirLoop.description: Air-side HVAC loop. Equipment items are connected sequentially (air flows through them in order).

system_type.description: Optional system type hint. Auto-detected if omitted: VAV fan -> vav, damper=1.0 -> doas, default -> psz_ac. Use 'fcu' explicitly for fan coil units.

condenser_type.description: Condenser type for CRAC systems. For water_cooled, the cooling coil's plant connection provides the condenser loop.

min_vav_fraction.description: Minimum VAV box flow fraction [0-1]. Only used for VAV systems.

availability_schedule.description: Schedule name. When schedule value is 0, system is OFF.

dcv.description: Demand-controlled ventilation: recalculate the minimum OA each timestep from current occupancy x per-person OA + per-area OA (ASHRAE 62.1 VRP). Uses per_person_oa / per_area_oa on the zone terminals.

equipment.description: Supply-side equipment in air flow order.

zone_terminals.description: Zone terminal connections served by this air loop. (Alias: 'zones' is accepted for backward compatibility.)

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

efficiency_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for efficiency f(PLR).

Chiller.description: Electric chiller with COP and optional condenser water loop connection.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

capacity.description: Nominal cooling capacity [W]. May be omitted when a205_file is set.

design_chw_flow.description: Design chilled water flow rate [m3/s]. Auto-calculated if 0.

condenser_plant_loop.description: Name of the condenser water plant loop. Required for water_cooled chillers.

condenser_entering_temp.description: Water-cooled only: fixed condenser entering water temperature [C] (E+ scheduled condenser setpoint). If omitted, outdoor wet-bulb + tower_approach is used.

tower_approach.description: Water-cooled fallback: approach from outdoor wet-bulb to condenser entering water temperature [C]. Only used when condenser_entering_temp is not set.

capft.description: Capacity-f(T) biquadratic curve. x = leaving CHW temp, y = entering condenser temp.

capft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve used as CAPFT. Alternative to inline capft. Ignored when a205_file is set.

eirft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve used as EIRFT. Alternative to inline eirft.

eirfplr_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve used as EIRFPLR. Alternative to inline eirfplr.

a205_file.description: Path to an ASHRAE Standard 205 RS0001 chiller performance file (.a205 CBOR or .a205.json), relative to the model YAML or absolute. When set, cop, capacity and curve fields are ignored.

PumpRole.description: Pump role in the plant loop. 'single' = standalone pump, 'primary' = constant flow through boiler/chiller, 'secondary' = variable flow distribution pump, 'headered' = staged pump bank.

PumpControlStrategy.description: Pump control strategy. 'demand' = flow varies with load, 'continuous' = constant speed when plant is active, 'staged' = OFF unless staged on by plant controller, 'intermittent' = cycles on/off within the timestep to match demand (E+ Intermittent; same as demand for variable-speed pumps).

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

design_head.description: Design pump head [Pa]. Default ~60 ft H2O.

impeller_efficiency.description: Impeller/hydraulic efficiency [0-1]. Total efficiency = motor_efficiency * impeller_efficiency.

num_pumps.description: Number of pumps in headered configuration. Each pump's flow = total / num_pumps.

motor_heat_to_fluid_fraction.description: Fraction of motor inefficiency heat added to the fluid stream [0-1] (E+ Fraction of Motor Inefficiencies to Fluid Stream).

power_curve.description: Part-load power curve coefficients [c1, c2, c3, c4]. power_frac = c1 + c2*PLR + c3*PLR^2 + c4*PLR^3. Default: [0, 0, 0, 1] (affinity laws).

CoolingTower.description: Cooling tower for condenser water heat rejection. Single/two/variable-speed with effectiveness-NTU model and polynomial fan power curve.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

design_water_flow.description: Design water flow rate [m3/s]. Use 'autosize' to size from condenser demand.

fan_power_curve.description: Fan power ratio curve [C1..C5]: PLF = C1 + C2*PLR + C3*PLR^2 + C4*PLR^3 + C5*PLR^4. Default: E+ variable-speed tower curve [0.0058, 0.0740, -0.2180, 0.8517, 0.2866].

HeatExchanger.description: Water-to-water plate-and-frame heat exchanger for inter-loop connections. Placed on the demand loop, draws from the source loop. Supports always-on (general inter-loop HX) or economizer mode (waterside economizer).

source_loop.description: Name of the source plant loop this HX draws from / rejects to.

design_flow_rate.description: Design flow rate on the demand side [m3/s].

control_mode.description: Control mode. 'always_on' for general inter-loop connection, 'economizer' activates only when source temperature enables free cooling.

economizer_threshold.description: For economizer mode: activate when T_source < T_demand_in + threshold [C].

CurveInput.description: Inline performance curve coefficients (quadratic or biquadratic). The curve type is inferred from the number of coefficients.

coefficients.description: Curve coefficients. 3 = quadratic f(x) = c1 + c2*x + c3*x^2; 6 = biquadratic f(x,y) = c1 + c2*x + c3*x^2 + c4*y + c5*y^2 + c6*x*y.

TesControlStrategy.description: Thermal storage control strategy: full_storage (charge off-peak, discharge during peak hours), load_leveling (chiller runs at a constant rate; TES supplements demand), or {demand_limiting: {threshold_w}} (discharge to keep building peak demand below threshold [W]).

ThermalStorage.description: Thermal energy storage (chilled water or ice) plant component.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

ice_charge_cop_factor.description: COP penalty factor when making ice.

peak_hours.description: Peak hours (1-24) during which charging is suppressed.

ExternalPlant.description: Plant-side co-simulation proxy. Delegates each timestep to an external process via stdin/stdout JSON.

command.description: Command line used to launch the co-simulation process (e.g. [python, chiller.py]).

inputs.description: Input variable names sent to the process each timestep (e.g. return_temp_c, return_flow_kg_s, load_request_w, outdoor_temp_c, sim_time_s).

outputs.description: Output variable names expected back each timestep (e.g. supply_temp_c, power_w, thermal_output_w).

PlantEquipment.description: Plant-side equipment. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

PlantLoop.description: Water-side plant loop (hot water or chilled water).

staging_mode.description: Staging strategy for multiple chillers/boilers. sequential = load each unit fully before starting the next; equal_split = share load equally across units.

staging_threshold.description: PLR above which the next unit stages on in sequential mode [0-1].

PlantSetpointReset.description: Plant loop supply temperature reset linear with outdoor air temperature.

sp_min.description: Setpoint at oa_high [C] (CHW: coldest; HHW: warmest).

sp_max.description: Setpoint at oa_low [C] (CHW: warmest; HHW: coldest).

oa_low.description: Outdoor temperature at which the setpoint is sp_max [C].

oa_high.description: Outdoor temperature at which the setpoint is sp_min [C].

ZoneGroup.description: Named group of zones for referencing in thermostats and load definitions.

Thermostat.description: Zone thermostat with heating/cooling setpoints. Zones can reference zone group names.

zones.description: Zone names or zone group names.

thermostat_schedule.description: Optional hourly setpoint schedule (e.g. night setback). Each entry's [start_hour, end_hour] window overrides the constant setpoints; hours outside every window use heating_setpoint / cooling_setpoint.

ThermostatScheduleEntry.description: Setpoints for a time-of-day window, optionally restricted to a date range.

end_hour.description: End hour (inclusive). If end < start the window wraps past midnight.

start_month.description: Optional date-range start month. All four date fields must be given together; a range whose end precedes its start wraps across the new year.

SetpointControl.description: Fixed setpoint controller on a coil or component.

PlantLoopSetpointControl.description: Fixed setpoint controller on a plant loop.

Control.description: A control definition. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

ParametricRun.description: A single parametric run configuration. Override component parameters, swap weather files, or include template YAML sections.

name.description: Unique name for this run. Used in output filenames.

weather_file.description: Override weather file for this run (EPW path, relative to input file).

overrides.description: Scalar parameter overrides as 'ComponentName.field_name': value pairs. The component name must match a named object in the model (zone, thermostat, material, fan, coil, boiler, chiller, etc.). The field name must be a numeric field on that component (e.g., efficiency, cop, capacity, heating_setpoint).

includes.description: Section replacements from external YAML files (Level 2 — not yet implemented). 'include' is accepted as an alias.

SectionOverride.description: Replace top-level model sections with content from an external YAML file. Not yet implemented — scaffolding only.

file.description: Path to partial YAML file (relative to input file).

SweepInput.description: Sweep definition — automatically generate runs by varying a single parameter across a list of values or a numeric range.

values.description: Explicit list of values to sweep through. Can be combined with 'range' (explicit values come first, then range-generated values).

range.description: Generate values from min to max with a fixed step. Can be combined with 'values'.

SweepRange.description: Numeric range for sweep generation: produces values from min to max (inclusive) with the given step size.

Parametrics.description: Parametric analysis configuration. Define explicit runs with overrides, auto-generate runs from sweeps, or both. When both are present, explicit runs execute first, followed by expanded sweep runs.

runs.description: Explicit named runs with per-run overrides.

sweeps.description: Sweep definitions that auto-generate runs by varying parameters.

cross_product.description: If true, sweeps generate a Cartesian product of all parameter values (N1 x N2 x ... runs). If false (default), sweeps are zipped element-wise (all must have the same number of values).

Schedule.description: Named schedule with hourly fractional values for each day type.

weekday.description: Hourly fractional values for weekdays (Mon-Fri), hours 0-23.

weekend.description: Hourly fractional values for weekends (fallback for Sat and Sun if not specified).

holiday.description: Holiday hourly values (falls back to sunday, then weekend, then weekday).

seasons.description: Seasonal (date-range) day profiles. A matching period overrides the top-level day arrays; the top-level weekday is the fallback for days not covered by any period.

CompactSchedule.description: Compact schedule strings using EnergyPlus-inspired syntax, e.g. "0 until 8:00, 1.0 until 18:00, 0". A bare value without 'until' fills the remaining hours. Alternative to explicit 24-value arrays; individual days override their group (weekday = Mon-Fri, weekend = Sat-Sun).

ScheduleSeason.description: One date-range period of a seasonal schedule (inclusive; may wrap across the new year).

weekday.description: Hourly fractions for weekdays in this period.

weekend.description: Optional weekend profile for this period (falls back to weekday).

Material.description: Thermophysical material properties. Thickness is given on the construction layer. For a no-mass (resistance-only) material, set thermal_resistance; conductivity/density/specific_heat are then ignored.

conductivity.description: Thermal conductivity [W/(m*K)]. Ignored when thermal_resistance is set.

density.description: Density [kg/m3]. Ignored when thermal_resistance is set.

specific_heat.description: Specific heat [J/(kg*K)]. Ignored when thermal_resistance is set.

thermal_absorptance.description: Hemispherical emissivity for longwave radiation exchange. For layered constructions, the outside material value is used for exterior LW radiation and the inside material value for interior LW radiation.

thermal_resistance.description: Thermal resistance [m2*K/W] for a no-mass material (EnergyPlus Material:NoMass). Zero thermal mass; only resistance matters.

vapor_resistance_factor.description: Vapor resistance factor mu [-] relative to still air (HAMT moisture transport only).

sorption_isotherm.description: Sorption isotherm as [relative_humidity [0-1], moisture_content [kg/kg]] pairs (HAMT only).

liquid_transport_coeff.description: Liquid transport coefficient as [moisture_content [kg/kg], D_w [m2/s]] pairs (HAMT capillary term; omitted if absent).

thermal_absorptance_inside.description: Inside-face thermal absorptance (emissivity) [0-1]. Falls back to thermal_absorptance when absent.

Construction.description: Opaque construction as ordered material layers (outside to inside).

WindowConstruction.description: Window construction defined by overall thermal and solar properties.

solar_absorptance.description: Glass solar absorptance [0-1]. Estimated from SHGC if omitted.

glass_emissivity.description: Glass hemispherical emissivity for interior and exterior longwave radiation exchange. Defaults to 0.84 (uncoated soda-lime glass). Use lower values for low-e coatings.

pane_solar_transmittance.description: Per-pane solar transmittance at normal incidence [0-1]. With pane_solar_reflectance, enables Fresnel-based angular SHGC modifiers (e.g. 0.834 per 3 mm clear pane).

pane_solar_reflectance.description: Per-pane front solar reflectance at normal incidence [0-1] (e.g. 0.075 per 3 mm clear pane). Used with pane_solar_transmittance.

num_panes.description: Number of glass panes (1 = single, 2 = double, 3 = triple). With gap_width / pane_conductivity / pane_thickness, enables the first-principles ISO 15099 gas-gap thermal model instead of NFRC film stripping.

shading_control.description: Dynamic interior blind/shade control (#104). Triggers on solar irradiance or zone temperature; scales solar gains by blind_shgc/base_shgc when deployed.

type.description: Trigger type: `solar_threshold` deploys when incident beam on the glazing [W/m²] exceeds the threshold; `temperature` deploys when zone air temperature exceeds the setpoint [°C].

threshold.description: For solar_threshold: beam irradiance on glazing [W/m²] to deploy blind.

setpoint.description: For temperature: zone air temperature [°C] to deploy blind.

hysteresis.description: Dead-band below threshold/setpoint before blind retracts [same units as trigger].

blind_shgc.description: SHGC of window+blind assembly when deployed. Solar gains are multiplied by blind_shgc/base_shgc.

blind_u_factor.description: U-factor [W/(m²·K)] of window+blind assembly when deployed. Omit to keep the base window U-factor.

SimpleConstruction.description: Simplified construction using overall U-factor and lumped thermal capacity.

mass_outside.description: Place the thermal mass layer outside the insulation (e.g. ASHRAE 140 Case 900 exterior concrete block). Default: mass on the inside.

mass_conductivity.description: Mass layer thermal conductivity [W/(m*K)] (default 1.0; CMU 0.51, poured concrete 1.4). Heavyweight constructions (thermal_capacity >= 30 kJ/m2K) only.

mass_density.description: Mass layer density [kg/m3] (default 2000; CMU 1400, poured concrete 2300). Heavyweight constructions only.

FFactorConstruction.description: F-factor ground floor construction (ASHRAE F-factor method, E+ Construction:FfactorGroundFloor): Q = F x P x (T_zone - T_ground). Each surface using it must set exposed_perimeter.

thermal_capacity.description: Areal thermal capacity of the slab [J/(m2*K)].

ground_temperatures.description: Monthly ground temperatures [C], January–December (E+ Site:GroundTemperature:FCfactorMethod). If omitted, the building-level ground temperature model is used.

BoundaryCondition.description: Boundary condition: outdoor, ground, adiabatic, or adjacent zone name.

Surface.description: Building surface (wall, floor, roof, or window).

area.description: Surface area [m2]. Auto-calculated from vertices if 0.

azimuth.description: Outward normal azimuth [degrees from north, clockwise].

sun_exposure.description: Whether the exterior face receives solar radiation. Set false for slab-on-grade floors (E+ NoSun).

wind_exposure.description: Whether the exterior face sees wind-driven convection (false = natural convection only, E+ NoWind).

exposed_perimeter.description: Exposed perimeter [m] for F-factor ground floors. Required when the construction is an f_factor_constructions entry; U_eff = F x P / A.

height.description: Window height [m] for the ISO 15099 interior convection model (default sqrt(area)).

width.description: Window width [m] for the ISO 15099 interior convection model (default sqrt(area)).

WindowShading.description: Window shading devices (windows only). Shading polygons are generated from these parameters relative to the window geometry. Requires shading_calculation: detailed to have an effect.

depth.description: Projection depth from the wall plane [m].

offset_above.description: Vertical offset above the window top edge [m].

left_extension.description: Extension beyond the window's left edge [m].

right_extension.description: Extension beyond the window's right edge [m].

left_fin.description: Vertical fin on the left side of the window (viewed from outside).

right_fin.description: Vertical fin on the right side of the window (viewed from outside).

depth.description: Projection depth from the wall plane [m].

ShadingSurface.description: Detached shading surface (E+ Shading:Site:Detailed). Casts shadows only; no thermal mass or heat balance. Requires shading_calculation: detailed.

volume.description: Zone air volume [m3]. Auto-calculated from surfaces if 0.

floor_area.description: Zone floor area [m2]. Auto-calculated from floor surfaces if 0.

conditioned.description: Whether the zone is conditioned by HVAC.

limit_humidity_to_saturation.description: Cap zone air humidity ratio at saturation for the zone temperature (excess condenses). Matters for a sealed, idle zone that cools.

max_relative_humidity.description: Maximum relative humidity setpoint [%] (e.g. 60). HVAC switches to dehumidification cooling when zone RH exceeds this.

min_relative_humidity.description: Minimum relative humidity setpoint [%] (e.g. 30). Humidifier activates when zone RH falls below this.

duct_leakage.description: Duct leakage to an unconditioned space. With the airflow network enabled, adds a pressure-driving flow path carrying leaked duct air from this zone to the zone containing the ducts.

ambient_zone.description: Zone containing the ducts (typically unconditioned: attic, crawlspace).

supply_leakage_fraction.description: Supply duct leakage as a fraction of supply flow.

return_leakage_fraction.description: Return duct leakage as a fraction of supply flow.

supply_static.description: Supply duct static pressure at design flow [Pa]. With design_flow, leakage becomes pressure-dependent.

return_static.description: Return duct static pressure magnitude at design flow [Pa].

design_flow.description: Design supply mass flow [kg/s]; required for the pressure-dependent model.

room_air.description: In-zone vertical temperature stratification (constant-gradient room air model). Interior surfaces couple to local air at their height; return air leaves at the return-height temperature; occupied-height temperature is reported via zone:occupied_temperature.

gradient.description: Vertical temperature gradient [K/m], positive = warmer near ceiling.

schedule.description: Optional schedule scaling the gradient (e.g. 0 when fans force mixing).

return_height.description: Return/exhaust air height above floor [m] (default: ceiling).

mundt.description: Derive the gradient each timestep from loads and flow: Q_conv/(m_supply*cp*H), clamped to [0, gradient]; zero when the system is off.

control_at_thermostat_height.description: HVAC control senses the occupied/thermostat-height temperature instead of the zone mean.

comfort.description: Occupant thermal comfort parameters for PMV/PPD calculation (#102, #103). Omit to use defaults (1.2 met, 0.5 clo, 0.1 m/s).

air_velocity.description: Relative air velocity [m/s] at the occupant location.

solar_absorptivity.description: Short-wave absorptivity of the body/clothing for solar MRT correction (ASHRAE 55 Annex C).

species_generation.description: Passive species sources in this zone (requires species on the airflow network).

zone_multiplier.description: Number of identical copies of this zone (E+ Zone Multiplier). Loads, airflows and HVAC energy are multiplied; zone temperature is computed once.

infiltration.description: Zone-level infiltration: a single object or a list (e.g. envelope cracks + door opening). Prefer the top-level `infiltration` section for multi-zone assignment.

internal_gains.description: Zone-level internal gains. Prefer the top-level people / lights / equipment sections for multi-zone assignment.

internal_mass.description: Internal thermal mass (furniture, contents), modeled as adiabatic surfaces exchanging with the zone on both sides (E+ InternalMass).

ideal_loads.description: Zone-level ideal loads air system (on/off control to setpoints). Prefer the top-level `ideal_loads` section.

thermostat_schedule.description: Time-of-day (and optional date-range) setpoint overrides for this zone.

ventilation_schedule.description: Time-of-day ventilation entries for this zone. Prefer the top-level `ventilation` section.

min_indoor_temp.description: Only ventilate when zone temperature exceeds this [C].

outdoor_temp_must_be_lower.description: Only ventilate when outdoor is cooler than indoor.

solar_distribution.description: Fractions of transmitted solar absorbed by floor/walls/ceiling (should sum to 1).

exhaust_fan.description: Zone-level exhaust fan. Prefer the top-level `exhaust_fans` section.

pressure_rise.description: Design pressure rise [Pa] (0 = no fan power).

outdoor_air.description: Zone-level ASHRAE 62.1 outdoor air / exhaust requirement. Prefer the top-level `outdoor_air` section.

per_area.description: OA per floor area [m3/s per m2].

ach.description: OA as air changes per hour [1/h].

exhaust_per_area.description: Exhaust per floor area [m3/s per m2].

exhaust_ach.description: Exhaust as air changes per hour [1/h].

ZoneInfiltration.description: Zone-level infiltration (E+ ZoneInfiltration:DesignFlowRate): Q = Q_design x (A + B*|dT| + C*V + D*V^2) x schedule.

air_changes_per_hour.description: Alternative: infiltration rate [ACH] (converted using zone volume).

InfiltrationDensityBasis.description: Air density used to convert design volume flow to mass flow. `outdoor`: outdoor-air density (temperature-dependent mass flow). `zone`: zone-air density (E+ ZoneInfiltration:DesignFlowRate convention; required by ASHRAE 140 Section 10 furnace cases).

sensible_fraction.description: Sensible fraction of activity_level (remainder is latent).

sensible_gain_per_person.description: Explicit sensible gain [W/person]; overrides activity_level x sensible_fraction.

latent_gain_per_person.description: Explicit latent gain [W/person]; overrides activity_level x (1 - sensible_fraction).

return_air_fraction.description: Fraction of heat to the return air plenum [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use reporting.

lost_fraction.description: Fraction of heat that does not enter the zone [0-1].

latent_fraction.description: Latent fraction of the non-lost heat [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use reporting.

NaturalVentilation.description: Wind- and stack-driven natural ventilation through operable openings (E+ ZoneVentilation:WindandStackOpenArea). V = sqrt(V_wind^2 + V_stack^2).

effective_angle.description: Opening orientation [degrees from north, clockwise] for windward/leeward determination.

height_difference.description: Height difference for the stack effect [m].

min_indoor_temp.description: Minimum indoor temperature to allow ventilation [C].

max_indoor_temp.description: Maximum indoor temperature to allow ventilation [C].

schedule.description: Availability schedule (> 0 = available). If omitted, always available except on design days.

min_indoor_outdoor_delta_t.description: Only ventilate when T_zone - T_out >= this [K].

min_on_timesteps.description: Anti-cycling: once open, stay open at least this many timesteps.

min_off_timesteps.description: Anti-cycling: once closed, stay closed at least this many timesteps.

setpoint_reset.description: Widened thermostat setpoints while natural ventilation is active; ramps back over ramp_timesteps when it stops.

ramp_timesteps.description: Timesteps to ramp back to normal setpoints.

DataCenter.description: Data center zone physics: implicit hot/cold-aisle model with auto-generated IT equipment load.

it_load_kw.description: Total IT load [kW] (or use rack_count x kw_per_rack).

rack_inlet_temp_max_c.description: Cold-aisle supply temperature limit [C]. Derived from equipment_class if omitted.

equipment_class.description: ASHRAE equipment class (inlet max A1 32, A2 35, A3 40, A4 45 C).

containment_efficiency.description: Fraction of hot exhaust returned directly to the cooling unit rather than mixing with zone air.

airflow_m3_per_s_per_kw.description: Explicit airflow per IT kW [m3/s/kW]. Auto-calculated from rack temperature rise if omitted.

lighting_w_per_m2.description: Lighting power density in the data hall [W/m2] (default 5.0).

People.description: Occupancy definition assignable to one or more zones.

activity_level.description: Total metabolic heat [W/person], split into sensible/latent via sensible_fraction.

sensible_fraction.description: Sensible fraction of activity_level [0-1] (0.62 seated, 0.58 office, 0.50 walking, 0.38 heavy exercise).

sensible_gain_per_person.description: Sensible heat gain per person [W/person]. Alternative to activity_level * sensible_fraction. Overrides activity_level when specified.

latent_gain_per_person.description: Latent heat gain per person [W/person]. Alternative to activity_level * (1 - sensible_fraction). Overrides activity_level when specified.

radiant_fraction.description: Fraction of heat gain that is radiant [0-1].

Lights.description: Lighting definition assignable to one or more zones.

return_air_fraction.description: Fraction of heat to return air plenum [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting. Enables per-submeter output variables (e.g., submeter:Decorative:lighting).

lost_fraction.description: Fraction of heat that does not enter the zone [0-1]. Example: elevator with lost_fraction=0.95 means only 5% of heat enters the zone.

latent_fraction.description: Fraction of equipment heat that is latent (moisture-generating) [0-1]. Applied to non-lost portion: latent = power × (1 - lost_fraction) × latent_fraction. Examples: kitchen equipment, laundry.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

Infiltration.description: Infiltration definition using EnergyPlus wind/temperature coefficient model.

flow_per_floor_area.description: Flow per floor area [m3/s per m2].

flow_per_exterior_wall_area.description: Flow per exterior wall area [m3/s per m2].

constant_coefficient.description: Coefficient A in F = design * (A + B*dT + C*wind + D*wind^2).

VentilationCombiningMethod.description: How multiple ventilation sources are combined.

outdoor_temp_must_be_lower.description: Only ventilate when outdoor is cooler than indoor.

tag.description: Free-form tag for end-use subcategory reporting.

pressure_rise.description: Design pressure rise [Pa] (0 = no fan power).

total_efficiency.description: Total fan efficiency (fan x belt x motor x VFD) [0-1].

motor_in_airstream_fraction.description: Fraction of motor waste heat entering the exhaust airstream [0-1].

OaMethod.description: Method for combining per-person and per-area outdoor air rates. 'sum' adds both contributions; 'maximum' takes the larger of the two.

OutdoorAir.description: Outdoor air requirement definition for minimum ventilation sizing.

per_area.description: OA per floor area [m3/s per m2].

oa_method.description: Method for combining per-person and per-area rates. Default: 'sum'.

ach.description: Supply OA as air changes per hour [1/h].

exhaust_per_area.description: Exhaust per floor area [m3/s per m2].

exhaust_ach.description: Exhaust as air changes per hour [1/h].

exhaust_method.description: Method for combining exhaust rates. Default: 'sum'.

IdealLoads.description: Ideal loads air system for zone load testing without real HVAC.

thermostat_schedule.description: Time-of-day setpoint changes (e.g. ASHRAE 140 Case 640 night setback).

oneOf.description: Seasonal mains temperature (E+ Site:WaterMainsTemperature Correlation method).

max_monthly_delta.description: Maximum difference between monthly average outdoor temperatures [C].

latitude.description: Site latitude [degrees]. Defaults to the weather file latitude.

MainsTemperature.description: Cold water mains temperature: a fixed value [C] or {correlation: {...}}.

WaterHeater.description: Storage tank water heater with deadband thermostat control.

fuel_type.description: Fuel type. Unrecognized values fall back to gas.

efficiency.description: Thermal efficiency [0-1] for gas/electric; COP for heat_pump.

parasitic_power.description: Constant parasitic fuel draw that does not heat the tank (pilot, controls) [W].

control_type.description: Heater control: on/off cycling or modulating (tankless).

ambient_zone.description: Zone whose air temperature drives standby losses (default constant 20 C).

schedule.description: Fraction-of-peak schedule [0-1]. Always at peak if omitted.

use_temperature.description: Target use temperature at the fixture [C].

DhwSystem.description: Domestic hot water system: water heater, draw profiles and mains temperature.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

DhwPump.description: Optional DHW circulation pump; runs whenever there is a draw. Same fields as the plant `pump` equipment, without the `type` tag.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

motor_heat_to_fluid_fraction.description: Fraction of motor inefficiency heat added to the fluid [0-1].

power_curve.description: Part-load power curve coefficients [c1, c2, c3, c4].

RadiantPanel.description: Zone radiant panel (fin-tube radiator, chilled ceiling, electric radiant heater).

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

plant_loop.description: Plant loop name (required for hot_water and chilled_water).

ua.description: Optional UA [W/K]; output becomes UA x (T_water - T_zone) instead of PLR x rated_capacity.

ExteriorEquipment.description: Facility-level exterior load not assigned to any zone (parking lot lighting, signage). Adds to facility energy without zone gains.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use reporting (takes precedence over subcategory).

schedule.description: Fraction schedule [0-1]. Always at full power if omitted.

subcategory.description: Legacy end-use subcategory label; use submeter instead.

astronomical_clock.description: Only operate at night (solar altitude <= 0), like E+ Exterior:Lights AstronomicalClock.

ElectricalDistribution.description: Electrical distribution system (UPS and transformers). Losses are computed each timestep and reported as the ASHRAE 90.4 electrical loss component (ELC).

efficiency_curve.description: Optional efficiency curve f(PLR); constant efficiency_at_full_load if omitted.

VrfSystem.description: Variable refrigerant flow system: one outdoor unit serving multiple zone indoor units.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

cooling_cap_ft.description: Cooling capacity curve name f(outdoor_db, indoor_t).

cooling_eir_ft.description: Cooling EIR curve name f(outdoor_db, indoor_t).

heating_cap_ft.description: Heating capacity curve name f(outdoor_db, indoor_t).

heating_eir_ft.description: Heating EIR curve name f(outdoor_db, indoor_t).

VrfIndoorUnit.description: VRF indoor unit (fan coil) serving one zone.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

Aggregation.description: Deprecated: aggregation is now per variable. Use an `@mean|@sum|@min|@max` suffix on a variable spec instead.

aggregation.description: Deprecated file-wide aggregation. Only applied to non-energy variables without an `@agg` suffix; prefer per-variable suffixes.

variables.description:
Variable specs to include in output. Format: `category:variable` (all entities) or `category:variable:name_filter` (specific entity or glob with `*`), optionally followed by `@mean`, `@sum`, `@min` or `@max` to override how the variable is reduced to the reporting frequency.

Default reduction: energy quantities (zone:heating_energy, zone:cooling_energy, building:*, submeter:*) are summed; everything else is time-averaged. Summing a rate integrates it over time, so W becomes Wh, kg/s becomes kg, m³/s becomes m³ and unmet/active flags become hours.

Examples: `zone:temperature`, `zone:temperature@max`, `zone:temperature:living_unit1`, `surface:transmitted_solar:Window*`, `building:fan_electric`, `component:outlet_temperature`.

**Site variables:** site:outdoor_temperature [°C], site:wind_speed [m/s], site:direct_normal_radiation [W/m²], site:diffuse_horizontal_radiation [W/m²], site:relative_humidity [%]

**Zone state variables:** zone:temperature [°C], zone:humidity_ratio [kg/kg], zone:heating_rate [W], zone:cooling_rate [W], zone:heating_energy [J], zone:cooling_energy [J], zone:infiltration_mass_flow [kg/s], zone:nat_vent_flow [m³/s], zone:nat_vent_mass_flow [kg/s], zone:nat_vent_active [-], zone:internal_gains_convective [W], zone:internal_gains_radiative [W], zone:supply_air_temperature [°C], zone:supply_air_mass_flow [kg/s]

**Zone gain breakdown (all W, positive = heat into zone):** zone:gain_people_sensible, zone:gain_people_latent, zone:gain_lighting, zone:gain_equipment_sensible, zone:gain_equipment_latent, zone:gain_infiltration_sensible, zone:gain_infiltration_latent, zone:gain_ventilation_sensible, zone:gain_ventilation_latent, zone:gain_natural_ventilation_sensible, zone:gain_natural_ventilation_latent, zone:gain_solar, zone:gain_hvac_sensible, zone:gain_hvac_latent

**Zone comfort variables:** zone:mean_radiant_temperature [°C] (long-wave, area-weighted surface MRT), zone:effective_mrt [°C] (long-wave MRT + solar correction; the MRT that drives PMV and operative temperature), zone:operative_temperature [°C], zone:pmv [-] (Predicted Mean Vote, −3 cold … 0 neutral … +3 hot), zone:ppd [%] (Predicted Percentage Dissatisfied), zone:solar_mrt_correction [K] (ASHRAE 55 Annex C direct-beam solar MRT increment)

**Zone unmet variables:** zone:unmet_heating [-] (0 or 1; summed → hours), zone:unmet_cooling [-] (0 or 1; summed → hours)

**Surface variables:** surface:inside_temperature [°C], surface:outside_temperature [°C], surface:inside_convection_coefficient [W/(m²·K)], surface:incident_solar [W/m²], surface:transmitted_solar [W], surface:cond_inside [W], surface:convection_inside [W], surface:radiation_inside [W], surface:inside_radiation_coefficient [W/(m²·K)], surface:blind_deployed [-] (1=deployed, 0=retracted; only emitted for windows with shading_control)

**Component variables:** component:outlet_temperature [°C], component:inlet_temperature [°C], component:mass_flow [kg/s], component:outlet_humidity_ratio [kg/kg], component:electric_power [W], component:fuel_power [W], component:thermal_output [W], component:cop_operating [-], component:plr [-], component:rtf [-], component:sensible_load [W], component:latent_load [W], component:total_load [W], component:conduction_loss [W], component:leakage_loss [W], component:pressure_rise [Pa], component:total_efficiency [-], component:effectiveness [-]. Use name_filter to select a specific component: `component:outlet_temperature:MyAHU`.

**Building energy meters (summed → Wh):** building:fan_electric, building:cooling_electric, building:heating_electric, building:heating_gas, building:pump_electric, building:heat_rejection, building:humidification, building:heat_recovery, building:dhw_electric, building:dhw_gas, building:lighting, building:ext_lighting, building:equipment, building:ext_equipment, building:total_electric, building:total_gas

**Submeter variables (summed → Wh):** submeter:total_electric, submeter:total_gas, submeter:total, submeter:lighting, submeter:equipment, submeter:heating_gas, submeter:cooling_electric, submeter:fan_electric, submeter:dhw_gas. Use name_filter to select a specific submeter: `submeter:lighting:Decorative`.
